# Which of your workflow steps run on a deprecated Node runtime?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and list every actions/* step pinned to a major that runs on a deprecated Node runtime (Node 12 or 16) or that GitHub has shut down. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
